metadata.title: Portable Power Station Product Catalog
notes: Products are limited to the seven brands requested by the user.
Only portable power stations are included; solar panels and other accessories are excluded.
Specifications are normalized from the specifications displayed on the Star Tech category/product listings available at collection time.
A null value means the corresponding specification was not stated in the source listing reviewed.

input_power_update.method: Maximum charging/input power normalized to watts. Where the source supplied voltage/current together with an explicit maximum wattage, that published wattage was used. No unsupported wattage was fabricated.

additional_product_research.scope: Additional portable power station models found outside the original Star Tech category listings.
additional_product_research.important_note: This is a cross-source expansion, not a guarantee of every model ever sold globally. Accessories, expansion batteries, solar panels, and fixed home-storage systems were excluded.
additional_product_research.source_policy: Manufacturer pages were preferred; non-StarTech retailer/catalog sources were used where manufacturer pages did not expose a suitable listing.
